Accomplishment

The first author to win three Asian American Literary Awards

Waylaid (2002) won a Members' Choice Award at the Asian American Literary Awards and also a Booklist Editors' Choice Award in Fiction in 2002. The novel was adapted into a film by Michael Kang, The Motel.

This Is A Bust(2007) won a Members' Choice Award at the Asian American Literary Awards.

Snakes Can’t Run won an Asian American Literary Award
